weekend_trip.title: Weekend plans
weekend_trip.description: Decide how to spend the weekend together.

questions.weekend_plan: What should we do this weekend?

conversations.went_out: Whatever we picked, it was our weekend.

questions.want_to_buy: Would you like to buy a house?

conversations.leave_open: We leave the housing question open for now.

child_activity_signup.title: Extracurricular activities
child_activity_signup.description: Your 7-year-old came home with three flyers from the neighborhood: swimming, soccer, and an art workshop. Time to pick something — or not.

questions.which_activity: What activity do you want to enroll your kid in?

options.swimming: Swimming lessons at the municipal pool
options.soccer: Saturday soccer at the neighborhood field
options.art: Art and crafts workshop at the cultural center

conversations.swimming: They've got a shirt and a schedule now. Let's see if they actually learn to swim.
conversations.soccer: Registration paid and first practice on Saturday. Hope they like it.
conversations.art: They showed up with a sketch folder. The living room already smells like tempera paint.
conversations.none: We told them maybe next year. They didn't look convinced.

timeline.swimming: We enrolled our kid in swimming lessons
timeline.soccer: We enrolled our kid in youth soccer
timeline.art: We enrolled our kid in an art workshop

questions.career_choice: Do you accept the promotion with more hours?

couples_therapy_suggestion.title: Couples therapy
couples_therapy_suggestion.description: The rough patches in your relationship are showing. Your family suggests seeing a professional couples therapist.

questions.therapy_choice: Our family is suggesting couples therapy. What do we do?
questions.therapy_choice_self: Our family is suggesting couples therapy. What do we do?

options.whatever_it_takes: Whatever it takes to help this relationship.
options.budget_therapy: Fine, let's go — but to an affordable one.

conversations.not_interested: With this attitude, we're not getting anywhere.
conversations.therapy_breakup: The therapist was blunt: this relationship makes no sense — we should call it quits.
conversations.therapy_works: The therapist told us everything has a solution, that we love each other and that's what matters.

midlife_checkpoint.title: Midlife checkpoint
midlife_checkpoint.description: A chance to step into a new life stage.

questions.midlife_stance: How do you meet this turning point?

conversations.stagnate: Maybe we are not ready to call this a new chapter.

burnout.title: Burnout
burnout.description: Work pressure reaches a breaking point.

questions.burnout_choice: How do you respond to burnout?

going_bald.title: Going bald
going_bald.description: The hairline is receding and you two have to pick a plan.

questions.what_to_do: Oh no, {{partnerBName}} is going bald. What do you think is best?
questions.what_to_do_self: Oh no, you're going bald. What do you think is best?

options.let_nature: Let nature do its thing and wear the bald patch with pride.
options.buzz_cut: Buzz it off and own being bald like a grown-up.
options.hide_it: Get creative with haircuts to hide the bald spots.

conversations.let_nature: Bald patch out in the open. No drama.
conversations.implant: It cost us, but the hair is coming back.
conversations.hide_it: Every morning it's a new haircut to cover this.
conversations.mismatch: Well... it's your hair, but I want you to know I don't agree.

friend_who_wont_leave.title: The friend who won't leave
friend_who_wont_leave.description: A friend who came from Madrid asked to crash for a few days after a brutal trip. Those days turned into months, and the hints aren't landing anymore.

questions.what_to_do: What do you do with him?

options.lock_out: Leave his bags outside and change the lock.
options.ask_nicely: Ask him nicely to find somewhere else.
options.split_rent: He can stay if he chips in on the rent.
options.let_stay: That's what friends are for. He can stay as long as he needs.

conversations.lock_out: Bags outside, new lock. The free hotel is closed.
conversations.ask_nicely: We asked nicely. It was time he found his own place.
conversations.split_rent: If he stays, he chips in on rent. That makes it hurt less.
conversations.let_stay: He can stay. That's what friends do, even if the place feels small.
conversations.mismatch: We're not on the same page about the friend. This is going to get awkward.

timeline.lock_out: Changed the lock on our houseguest
timeline.ask_nicely: Asked him to find somewhere else
timeline.split_rent: The friend stays, but he chips in on rent
timeline.let_stay: The friend stays as long as he needs

entertaining_job_offers.title: Entertaining job offers
entertaining_job_offers.description: {{partnerAName}} got offered a really fun job. Several options are on the table, and finances aren't good enough to shrug them off.

options.calama_big_salary: Huge salary in Calama: excellent house up north, but we're moving far away.
options.puerto_aysen_good_salary: Good pay in Puerto Aysén: ok house down south, better vibes.
options.san_fernando_mid_salary: Mid-high salary in San Fernando: ok house and a moderate move.
options.daily_commute: Better pay than now, but 1 hr 15 of daily commuting in the city.

conversations.calama_big_salary: Calama it is. The money is serious, but the desert and the distance hit hard.
conversations.puerto_aysen_good_salary: Puerto Aysén sounds nice. South, a decent house, and a calmer pace.
conversations.san_fernando_mid_salary: San Fernando — middle ground. Not a huge move, not huge money, but it adds up.
conversations.daily_commute: We stay put, but that daily commute will wreck us. The job pays; the traffic doesn't.
conversations.mismatch: Fine, some things are a couple decision — but we're talking about my career here.

timeline.puerto_aysen_good_salary: Took the job in Puerto Aysén
timeline.san_fernando_mid_salary: Took the job in San Fernando
timeline.daily_commute: Took the job with a daily commute

adult_content_deal.title: The playful friend's business
adult_content_deal.description: A peculiar, very playful friend pitches a business. He says you've got everything you need: you're good-looking and elegant. He asks if you want to make adult content. He swears you'll go viral and make serious money, but it isn't a one-off: it's a two-year contract.

options.go_all_in: Money and shame are two things we don't have. Let's go!
options.mask_only: Mmm, it's tempting, but I'd want to hide my face with a mask.
options.decline_values: My Catholic school values don't allow it. No thanks.

conversations.go_all_in: We signed the two years. The money comes in, and the embarrassment... we'll deal with that later.
conversations.mask_only: We're in, but with a mask. The face stays off camera; the rest doesn't.
conversations.decline_values: Thanks, but no. Catholic school still has a hold on us.
conversations.mismatch: We're nowhere near agreeing on shooting adult content.

timeline.adult_cinema_job: Started a new job in adult cinema

buy_luxury_car.title: Time to treat ourselves?
buy_luxury_car.description: Finances are in great shape and we can think about something fancier. A few premium cars are on the table.

options.bmw_320i: BMW 320i — elegant, sporty, with that iconic grille
options.audi_a4: Audi A4 2.0 TFSI — understated, techy, with quattro AWD
options.mercedes_c200: Mercedes-Benz C200 — classic luxury, comfort, and status
options.volvo_xc40: Volvo XC40 Recharge — premium SUV, safe, with Scandinavian flair

conversations.bmw_320i: BMW 320i in the driveway. You feel that sporty handling from the first start.
conversations.audi_a4: Audi A4 is ours. Tech, leather, and that sense we've stepped up a level.
conversations.mercedes_c200: Mercedes C200. Comfort, status, and the star on the wheel. We look different now.
conversations.volvo_xc40: Volvo XC40. Safe, premium, and room to hit the mountains in style.
conversations.mismatch: We couldn't agree on a luxury car. The splurge will have to wait.

buy_mid_range_car.title: Time to buy a car?
buy_mid_range_car.description: Finances are looking good and we can finally think about getting our own wheels. A few mid-range models are on the table.

options.chevrolet_onix: Chevrolet Onix 1.4 LT — compact, affordable, great for the city
options.nissan_kicks: Nissan Kicks Advance — small SUV, comfy with good ground clearance
options.toyota_corolla: Toyota Corolla XEi — the reliable classic, no surprises
options.mazda_3: Mazda 3 2.0 — the nicest pick of the bunch, great to drive

conversations.chevrolet_onix: Onix is ours. Small, efficient, and fits in any parking spot.
conversations.nissan_kicks: Kicks in the driveway. Tall, comfy, and ready for a weekend in the mountains.
conversations.toyota_corolla: New Corolla. Classic, reliable, and it won't leave us stranded on the highway.
conversations.mazda_3: Mazda 3. Drives like a dream and we feel a step up every time we head out.
conversations.mismatch: We couldn't agree on a car. On foot for a while longer.

upgrade_housing.title: Time to move?
upgrade_housing.description: Finances are looking good and we can afford something better. A few options are on the table.

options.trapenses_house: A nice house in Los Trapenses
options.pedro_valdivia_apartment: A good apartment in Pedro de Valdivia Norte
options.chicureo_house: An excellent house in a Chicureo gated community
options.metro_salvador_apartment: An excellent apartment near Metro Salvador

conversations.trapenses_house: House in Los Trapenses. Space, views, and fresh air.
conversations.nunoa_apartment: Apartment in Ñuñoa, close to everything.
conversations.pedro_valdivia_apartment: Apartment in Pedro de Valdivia Norte. Solid, comfortable, not too far out.
conversations.chicureo_house: House in a Chicureo gated community. Pool, grill, and that closed-neighborhood life.
conversations.metro_salvador_apartment: Apartment near Metro Salvador. Downtown in minutes and a great building.
conversations.mismatch: It seems like we have different life goals.

timeline.pedro_valdivia_apartment: We moved to Pedro de Valdivia Norte

work_party_crush.title: Someone from the party
work_party_crush.description: Things don't seem to be going well with {{partnerAName}}, and you met someone at a coworker's birthday party. After chatting for a while you open up about your problems, and they reply with suggestive photos saying: "Maybe I can help you out."

options.keep_playing: Keep playing along — what they don't know won't hurt them.
options.decline_situation: Tell them you're not comfortable with this.
options.tell_and_leave: Tell {{partnerAName}} what happened and end the relationship.

conversations.caught_partner_a: I found out. Did you really do this?
conversations.caught_partner_b: When a lioness neglects her lion, he goes looking for Bambi.

timeline.secret_affair: We kept playing along in secret

how_well_do_you_know.title: How well do you know your partner!
how_well_do_you_know.description: The classic quiz. Six questions to see if you actually know each other.

questions.first_kiss_guess: Guess what {{partnerAName}} put: who gave the first kiss?
questions.better_gifts_guess: Guess what {{partnerAName}} put: who gives better gifts?
questions.messier_guess: Guess what {{partnerAName}} put: who is messier?
questions.more_jealous_guess: Guess what {{partnerAName}} put: who is more jealous?
questions.better_cook_guess: Guess what {{partnerAName}} put: who cooks better?
questions.said_love_first: Who said I love you first?
questions.said_love_first_guess: Guess what {{partnerAName}} put: who said I love you first?

conversations.score_0: Zero out of six. This isn't a couple, it's a mystery.
conversations.score_1: Just one. Do we even live together?
conversations.score_2: Only two. We're kind of flying blind here.
conversations.score_3: Three out of six. Mid: not great, not terrible.
conversations.score_4: Four right. We know each other... somewhat.
conversations.score_5: Almost a clean sweep. Just one slipped away.
conversations.score_6: Six out of six! We know each other by heart.

timeline.quiz: Played how well do you know your partner

aunt_pepita_inheritance.title: Aunt Pepita's inheritance
aunt_pepita_inheritance.description: You got 2 million pesos from distant Aunt Pepita. What do you do with the money?

questions.what_to_do: What do we do with the 2 million?

options.brazil_vacation: A solid week-long vacation in Brazil
options.save_money: Save it — the one who saves always has something
options.donate_hogar_cristo: Donate it to Hogar de Cristo

conversations.brazil_vacation: A week in Brazil: beach, caipirinhas, zero guilt. Wellness went up on its own.
conversations.save_money: Straight into savings. The one who saves always has something.
conversations.wardrobe_refresh: Wardrobe upgrade: blazer and sweater for both of us. New level unlocked.
conversations.donate_hogar_cristo: Aunt Pepita's money went straight to Hogar de Cristo. Felt right.
conversations.all_on_red_win: RED HIT! The 2 million multiplied. We made money and laughed all the way to the bank.
conversations.all_on_red_lose: Nothing. Zero. The roulette ate the 2 million like they were free drinks. Bye money, bye peace of mind.
conversations.all_on_red_lose_partner_b: I said we shouldn't... but we bet it all anyway.

timeline.donation: Donated Aunt Pepita's inheritance to Hogar de Cristo

partner_b_headache.title: The headache won't quit
partner_b_headache.description: {{partnerBName}} has had a headache for 4 days. Money's tight and the pain isn't going away.

questions.what_to_do: {{partnerBName}} has had a headache for 4 days. What do we do?
questions.what_to_do_self: You've had a headache for 4 days. What do we do?

options.wait_it_out: Wait to heal or die, whichever comes first.

conversations.medical_check: We went to the checkup. It costs money, but at least we know what it is.
conversations.hospitalized: I told you. Now we're stuck with hospital bills on top of everything.
conversations.recovered: It passed on its own. We got lucky, but I didn't love that gamble.
conversations.mismatch: So much disagreement over a headache.

timeline.ignored_illness: {{partnerBName}} got sick and did nothing about it

pet_parenting_style.title: How do we raise {{mascotName}}?
pet_parenting_style.description: You've had a pet for a while and the differences are showing: space in the apartment, money on food, even social media.

questions.rearing_style: What parenting style do we want for {{mascotName}}?

options.free_roam_bedroom: {{mascotName}} can roam free through the whole house and has a bed in the bedroom. We're the luckiest pet parents.
options.restricted_premium_food: {{mascotName}} can only go in certain parts of the house, but always gets the best food.
options.basics_only: {{mascotName}} has a roof and food. That's enough for an animal.
options.instagram_page: {{mascotName}} is getting their own Instagram page.

plaza_pet_adoption.title: Pets in the plaza
plaza_pet_adoption.description: On some random Sunday, ice cream in hand, you're walking through the neighborhood plaza when a couple of hippies show up offering animals for adoption. Despite the incense smell, you go over for a look.

options.adopt_dog_enrique: Adopt Enrique, a 10-year-old dog. You could give him a few good last years.
options.adopt_poodle_copito: Take home Copito de Nieve, a white poodle. He seems sweet and has his whole life ahead.
options.adopt_hamsters: The little group of hamsters looks like exactly what you need. You take them.
options.walk_away: You figure the humans probably gave the animals fleas, and you'd rather pass.

conversations.adopt_dog_enrique: Enrique is getting on in years, but he looks grateful. The apartment feels different with him around.
conversations.adopt_poodle_copito: Copito de Nieve is white as snow and already wants up on the couch. Welcome home.
conversations.adopt_kitten_ulises: Ulises won't stop exploring every corner. The kitten already runs the place.
conversations.adopt_hamsters: The hamsters arrived as a crew and took over the coffee table. At least they're cute.
conversations.walk_away: Better stick with the ice cream. Between the incense and the fleas, we kept walking.

timeline.adopt_poodle_copito: We adopted Copito de Nieve, the white poodle
timeline.adopt_hamsters: We adopted a little group of hamsters

separation_reconciliation.title: One last chance
separation_reconciliation.description: You're separated and things are tense. Maybe there's still something to try — or maybe not.

questions.how_to_return: What would you like {{partnerBName}} to do to win the relationship back?
questions.how_to_return_self: What would you do to win the relationship back?

options.guitar_serenade: Show up with a guitar at a family event of yours and dedicate a sweet song they wrote.
options.instagram_likes: Like every story you post on Instagram.
options.photo_letter: Write a letter with photos, remembering all the good times you shared.
options.no_second_chances: There are no good second acts in this life (except Shrek).

conversations.guitar_serenade: They showed up with a guitar at my family BBQ and sang a song they wrote. Ridiculous and sweet at the same time.
conversations.instagram_likes: Liked everything — even the 3 a.m. coffee story. At least the effort showed.
conversations.photo_letter: A letter with photos from trips, birthdays, and the old apartment. We laughed, cried, and talked seriously again.
conversations.beg_on_knees: On their knees in the square with people watching. Total embarrassment, but it felt real.
conversations.no_second_chances: Shrek, yes. Us, no. That simple.
conversations.mismatch: We couldn't even agree on how to come back. We're done.

timeline.attempt: We tried to come back after the separation

separation_closure.title: The end
separation_closure.description: You already tried. You're still apart and there's nothing left to say.

conversations.partner_a: Thanks for all the good times. I really hope you're okay.
conversations.partner_b: Same. Take care. It was good while it lasted.

want_kids_decision.title: Do we want a baby?
want_kids_decision.description: You've been together a while, and at some dinner or late-night talk the topic comes up: kids. Time to put it on the table.

questions.want_kids: Do we want to have a child?

conversations.no: You know the rule — no glove, no love.

first_baby_gender.title: A new life
first_baby_gender.description: What joy — you've conceived a little one. For some divine reason, you get to choose the child's sex.

conversations.mismatch: Well, we don't agree on this, but we'll love them anyway.

unplanned_pregnancy.title: An unexpected miracle
unplanned_pregnancy.description: No birth control is foolproof — the miracle of life happened and you've conceived.

sex_toys_exploration.title: Curiosity at the shop
sex_toys_exploration.description: After talking with some friends, you decide to explore sex toys. You do a bit of research online and see these options.

options.handcuffs_ropes: A nice set of handcuffs and ropes

conversations.handcuffs_ropes: The set arrived. We tried it carefully and laughed more than we expected.
conversations.tarzan_costume: The Tarzan costume was ridiculous. That night was pure embarrassed laughter.
conversations.little_whip: The whip was smaller than we imagined. Still, it helped break the ice.
conversations.skip_this_time: We closed the tab and left the idea for later. At least we talked about it.

vacation_week_decision.title: Where should we go on vacation?
vacation_week_decision.description: Vacation week is coming up and you need to pick a plan. Every option has its vibe — and its price tag.

questions.where_to_go: What do we do with the week off?

options.brazil_with_friends: Fly to Brazil with friends who go there all the time
options.family_beach_house: Head to the family beach house
options.usa_trip: Visit the land of freedom and opportunity
options.southern_chile: Road-trip southern Chile for new adventures

conversations.brazil_with_friends: Brazil with the friends. Caipirinhas, beach days, long nights. The bill was long too.
conversations.family_beach_house: Family beach house. Good food, sun, and barely any spending.
conversations.usa_trip: The United States. Parks, malls, the whole cliché. The credit card felt it.
conversations.southern_chile: Southern Chile for adventure. Hikes, lakes, and a full recharge.
conversations.mismatch: We can't even agree on a vacation!

timeline.family_beach_house: Week at the family beach house
